notes.title: minor update to previous!
notes.content:
aaaahhh i accidentally included data files from a pre-expansion build, but with a new executable
so expansion stuff was crashing!
should be fixed now.

i think i've fixed some of the display issues but not all, still testing!

also, by the way, i'm working on a sequel: [url=https://www.backerkit.com/c/projects/michael-brough/868-back]868-BACK[/url]
you can pre-order / crowdfund it now if you want!
it's a big new game. more on that in a bit!
